payload.text: The Brennecke Institute developed a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery intended to reduce electrolyte crossover, a key aging mechanism in sodium-flow systems. An independent audit established the corrected cycle life at 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity threshold. The cell’s gravimetric energy density is 148 Wh/kg, and projected stack-level cost at 500 MWh manufacturing scale is $61/kWh. The chemistry cannot operate below 4 °C because the thalliline dopant precipitates from the negative electrolyte.
